# `silk/tls/trust_source_native`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

A native `TrustSource` provider that loads trust anchors from one PEM file.

## When to use
Provide `NativeFileTrustSource` for `TrustSource` when your program uses one PEM bundle of CA
certificates, for example `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` on Debian or `/etc/ssl/cert.pem`
on macOS.
On Windows, configure a normalized native drive root such as `C:\certs` and a portable
path beneath it. Local NTFS and the Windows filesystem provider restrictions apply.

## Details
`NativeFileTrustSource.make` copies the root directory and the path. It does no I/O. Each
`load` opens the file again, reads at most the input limit, closes it, and decodes it with
`TrustSnapshot.fromAnnotatedPem`. Text outside the certificate blocks is allowed. A bad block
fails the load. Each snapshot owns its anchors.

The path is opened below the root without following symbolic links, as in
`silk.platform.native.filesystem`. Trust the root and its parent directories. To change the file, write a
new file and rename it. A change in place can be read half way.

## Errors
`TrustSourceError` for bad configuration, a file error, a file over the input limit, or bad PEM.
`OutOfMemoryError` if the allocation fails.

## Gotchas
- It does not look for a default file, read environment variables, or use the trust store of the
  system (such as the macOS keychain). It does not check revocation.
- Supported targets are Windows x86_64 MSVC, Darwin x86_64 or aarch64, and GNU/Linux x86_64 or aarch64.

## Examples
### Configure a bundle and see a load fail
```silk
import silk.mem.allocator { Allocator, OutOfMemoryError }
import silk.core.effect { Effect }
import silk.core.result { Result }
import silk.system.filesystem { FileError, Path }
import silk.tls.trust_source_native { NativeFileTrustSource }
import silk.tls.trust_snapshot { TrustLoadLimits, TrustSourceError }
import silk.tls.trust_source { TrustSource }

effect fn program() -> i32
  ! FileError | TrustSourceError | OutOfMemoryError
  ? &mut Allocator {
  // On Debian, the bundle is /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt. On macOS, /etc/ssl/cert.pem.
  let bundle = run Path.fromBytes(b"/ca-certificates.crt")
  let debian = run NativeFileTrustSource.make(b"/etc/ssl/certs", &bundle)
  drop debian

  // `make` does no I/O. A missing file fails at `load`.
  let missing = run Path.fromBytes(b"/silk-doc-missing.pem")
  let mut source = run NativeFileTrustSource.make(b"/tmp", &missing)
  let loaded = run Effect.result(TrustSource.load(TrustLoadLimits.defaults()))
    |> Effect.provideMut<TrustSource>(&mut source)
  return match move loaded {
    Result.Success { value: _ } => 1
    Result.Failure { error: failure } => match move failure {
      TrustSourceError.File { operation: _, error: cause } => {
        drop cause
        return 0
      }
      _ => 1
    }
  }
}

effect fn failed<E>(error: E) -> i32 {
  drop error
  return 1
}

pub fn main() -> i32 {
  let mut allocator = Allocator.systemAllocatorProvider()
  return run Effect.catchAll(program(), failed) |> Effect.provideMut<Allocator>(&mut allocator)
}
```
